intro: Our Upmods Electra gives your space a soft glow. With its lit-up headboard and hidden storage, it’s designed for those who want both function and finesse.

features.title: Solid, stylish, and made to last
features.text: Built from sturdy engineered wood, our bed stands strong through the everyday while bringing modern elegance to your room. It’s form and function in perfect harmony.

features.title: Storage that blends into your day
features.text: Our bed features clever headboard storage and open-access box compartments — giving you easy reach to the things you use the most, without disrupting your calm space.

features.title: A ledge that displays your life
features.text: The built-in display ledge with a grommet lets you charge your devices neatly. Whether it's your phone, tablet or laptop, we’ve thought of it — so your space stays stylish and sorted.

features.title: Comfort you can lean into
features.text: Our cushioned headboard is designed to cradle your back in softness — whether you're enjoying a film, reading in bed or simply relaxing. It’s support with a soft touch.

features.title: Effortless access, clever storage
features.text: The box-style underbed compartments offer easy access to the things that matter. It’s smart storage that helps you make the most of your space, effortlessly. Plus, all Upmods beds come with versatile storage options to suit your unique lifestyle.

name: Upmods Electra Queen Size Engineered Wood Bed With Box Storage
